question.prompt: A bag contains 3 balls: 2 red and 1 white. Balls are drawn twice in succession. What is the probability that both draws are red: (1) with replacement; (2) without replacement? (Write the answers to (1) and (2) in order, as fractions in simplest form, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: (1) With replacement: there are \(3\times3=9\) outcomes in total, and \(2\times2=4\) outcomes in which both draws are red, so the probability is 4/9. (2) Without replacement: there are \(3\times2=6\) outcomes in total, and \(2\times1=2\) outcomes in which both draws are red, so the probability is \(2/6=1/3\).
solutions.title: Count ordered ball pairs
